note: Borgloon (Looz), old seat of the counts of Loon: wall and four gates from shortly after 1200, traced from the Ferraris map (1777), where the line is a ditch and hedge. Besieged by Lorraine in 1654.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Borgloon' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140046)

gateSources.Wellerpoort: inventory 140046 ('Wellerpoort of Hasseltse poort'); position uncertain
gateSources.Keulerpoort: inventory 140046 ('Keulerpoort, Nerempoort of Akense poort'); position uncertain
